name: Ahimaaz
overview: The name Ahimaaz appears in Scripture as a figure connected to prominent biblical leaders, illustrating loyalty and trusted service. He is identified as the father-in-law of King Saul through his daughter Ahinoam (1 Samuel 14:50), and also as the son of Zadok the high priest, demonstrating a priestly lineage (2 Samuel 15:36). Ahimaaz is noted for his faithfulness to King David, acting as a messenger alongside Jonathan, skillfully evading Absalom's servants to deliver critical news to the king (2 Samuel 17:17-20). Additionally, Ahimaaz is connected to Solomon as his son-in-law, further linking him to the Davidic covenant and royal family.
